title: 10 Most Colorful Cities in the World
description:
Check out all the places seen in this video: https://www.touropia.com/cities-with-colorful-houses/ 

If you're looking for somewhere that will brighten up your day - or researching your next holiday destination, look no further than these colorful cities. Whether they're hidden away among mountains, lying alongside the sea, or on an island in a lagoon, these brightly-colored cities are as photogenic and picturesque as they come. Freshly painted or fading from the passing of the centuries; these cities certainly count among the most colorful in the world.
author: touropia
